description: Splits self-stale witnesses by whether re-running the producer could change the payload. Normalisation drops comments, docstrings and formatting via ast.unparse; equality of the normalised sources means a re-run is bookkeeping only.
scope: scope-(a): decides only whether a re-run can move the payload. Says nothing about whether a witness is numerically correct, and ignores scriptCommitSha, which rebase-merge rewrites.
